scope: Complete tracked tree inventory with normalized product-specific names. Related Rust files indicate subsystem coverage, not per-module parity. Translation records identify the selected files with direct Rust adaptations, tests, and differences. Pending targets are planned paths, not placeholder code.

differences_and_remaining: Explicit instance configuration replaces the product-specific environment variable.
Rust module exports replace Python re-exports; not all original contracts exist.
No Python function-signature inference or decorators.
RetrievalControls, evidence mapper, rich examples and approval metadata remain pending.
Recursive schema validation adds strict oneOf and nested checks.
Telemetry integrations and legacy compatibility wrapper pending.
Generic Rust error text avoids leaking internal exception values.
Async Result callbacks replace Python exception hooks.
Embedding executor is separate from incident checkpoint orchestration.
Arc snapshots and atomic replacement replace callback/resource binding.
Explicit token budget replaces process-global environment lookup.
Integer overflow uses saturating arithmetic.
Python class validators and Protocol replaced by typed Rust constructors and traits.
Direct serde decoding does not normalize metadata; callers use normalization functions.
Native Rust stdio process ownership and bounded framing replace delegated Python SDK transport.
Explicit environment mappings, message/byte limits, cancellation cleanup, and no automatic call replay.
Legacy SSE mode, vendor normalization, OAuth, resources/prompts and general server requests remain absent.
Contract tests use synthetic peers; no side-by-side Python SDK or live vendor certification.
